stock.sub: An even split: 51% houses, 43% townhouses (2021 Census)

green_space.sub: Whites Hill Reserve's 170 hectares of trails and lookouts on the southern doorstep

stations.name: Closest stations are Coorparoo and Cannon Hill

buses.note: Route 204 runs Winstanley Street through the suburb; the Old Cleveland Rd edge carries 200, 204 and 222 (TransLink stop pages, 15 Aug 2026).

driving.approx_cbd_minutes_offpeak_note: Approximately 14 to 18 minutes to Brisbane CBD off-peak.

primary_state.name: Whites Hill State College P-12 for most streets; Carina SS (eastern strip) or Mt Gravatt East SS (southern pocket)

secondary_state.name: Whites Hill State College (Cavendish Road SHS for the southern pocket)

parks: Whites Hill Reserve (~170ha shared with Camp Hill; 13 tracks, two lookouts, dog park)
Anzac Road Park (the ANZAC memorial-streets pocket)
lifestyle.shops_dining_note: No strip of its own beyond the small Winstanley Street node (being redeveloped). Westfield Carindale is a short drive for big-format retail and dining. Camp Hill Marketplace, Martha Street and Coorparoo Square are within reach.

pockets.name: The Heights
pockets.character: The namesake 36m rise in the north-east. Hilltop blocks with outlooks, contemporary rebuilds replacing originals.

pockets.name: ANZAC streets
pockets.character: The WWI memorial street cluster: Anzac, Birdwood, Gallipoli, Mons, Salonica.

pockets.name: Reserve edge
pockets.character: Southern streets backing onto or walking to Whites Hill Reserve. Bushland outlooks and trail access.

pockets.name: Winstanley corridor
pockets.character: The suburb's spine and its one small shopping node, with the 204 bus through the middle.

buyer_profile.note: Buyers targeting the topography and the catchment combination.
Buyers who searched Camp Hill and discovered the hill continues east at a more accessible entry point.
Drawn to elevated blocks where an original home understates what the site can do.

pois.name: Whites Hill Reserve
pois.note: 170 hectares shared with Camp Hill. Trails, dog park, two lookouts.

pois.name: Whites Hill State College
pois.note: The P-12 catchment college, just over the Camp Hill line

pois.name: San Sisto College
pois.note: Girls college roughly a kilometre out, in Carina

pois.name: Winstanley Street node
pois.note: The suburb's one small shopping corner, being redeveloped

pois.name: Olivia Drive Park
pois.note: The big southern park near the reserve

pois.name: Pine Mountain
pois.note: 106 metres, beside the old quarry site
